# Leaf spring replacement and installation

> **[Unverified]** This page rests on a single community report. Cross-check before relying on it.

> Items marked **[Partial]** are only partly confirmed by the source and need more work. They stay in the review queue and are firmed up, corrected or removed as more sources come in.

## Summary

[Partial] Drop spare tire, jack rear end, unbolt shackles and U-bolts, then install new leaf springs with aligned perches. [t770]

## Procedure

> **[Partial]** Needs more work: the verifier could confirm only part of this procedure (the steps marked [Partial], or whether the list is complete). Steps or precautions may be wrong or missing; read the source thread before relying on it. Later runs fill it in as more sources are found.

1. Drop the spare tire to create more working space.
2. [Partial] Break loose the wheel nuts on the rear wheels.
3. Chock the front wheels for stability.
4. Jack up the rear end of the vehicle.
5. Place jack stands under the frame and axle, then remove the main jack.
6. Unbolt the shackles connecting the leaf springs to the frame (or just those connected to the leaves).
7. Remove the U-bolts holding the axle to the leaf springs on both sides.
8. Loosen a large 22mm nut held by a 19mm bolt using a bottle jack and breaker bar if necessary.
9. [Partial] Lift off the old leaf spring assembly from the frame.
10. Position the new leaf spring with its front side facing forward, ensuring sleeves sit inside bushings that match each hole.
11. [Partial] Bolt the rear of the leaf springs to the frame shackles first (hand-tightened) for easier alignment.
12. [Partial] Place U-bolts over the axle and position shims on top of the leaf spring perches if desired.
13. Jack up the axle slightly, then lower it so the perch centers align with the leaf center pins.
14. Compress both leaves simultaneously using two jacks to seat the axle flush against them.
15. Thread the U-bolt nuts through while compressed and tighten completely.

_Procedure reported by [t770]._

- [Partial] 22mm socket [t770]

## Tips & gotchas

- Use a buddy to help compress the leaves simultaneously. [t770]
- Install shims on leaf perches if you want to reduce vibrations. [t770]
- [Partial] Hand-tighten bolts initially before final torquing after assembly is complete. [t770]
